-- ButtonTemplateView: shared button factory (font, colors, template).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local M = {}
M.Font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Fondamento)
M.Color = Color3.fromRGB(46, 30, 16)
-- Book-menu look: ink on brandon's parchment kit, matching the side tabs.
local INK, RED = M.Color, Color3.fromRGB(128, 36, 22)
local STRIP, STRIP_ACTIVE = "rbxassetid://97760911897294", "rbxassetid://71221942296508" -- red / purple bound strips
local STRIP_SLICE = Rect.new(85, 30, 430, 104)
local active, root, host, template, hud

-- Initializes the shared button template.
local function init()
	if root then return end
	hud = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("ButtonTemplateHUD")
	hud.ResetOnSpawn = false; hud.DisplayOrder = 1005; hud.Enabled = true
	root = hud:WaitForChild("Frame")
	host = root:WaitForChild("Holder"):WaitForChild("Frame")
	template = host:WaitForChild("ButtonHolder")
	template.Visible = false
	root.Visible = false
	root.Active = true
	host.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)M.Skin(d)end)
	for _, d in host:GetDescendants()do M.Skin(d)end
end

-- Light text becomes ink and gold highlights become red, so pages read on parchment.
local function inked(c)
	local hi, lo = math.max(c.R, c.G, c.B), math.min(c.R, c.G, c.B)
	if hi > .55 and hi - lo < .22 then return INK end
	if c.R > .65 and c.G > .5 and c.B < .6 and c.R - c.B > .2 then return RED end
	return nil
end

-- Restyles one piece of a page (called for everything placed on the pages).
function M.Skin(d)
	if d:IsA("TextLabel")or d:IsA("TextButton")or d:IsA("TextBox")then
		local function recolor()local c = inked(d.TextColor3); if c then d.TextColor3 = c end end
		recolor(); d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(recolor)
		d.FontFace = M.Font; d.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
		if d.Text=="×" then d.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold) end
		-- Page headings take the red of the open side tab.
		if d:IsA("TextLabel")and d.Name~="Caption" and d.TextSize >= 21 then d.TextColor3 = RED end
		if d:IsA("TextBox")then
			d.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 202, 162); d.BackgroundTransparency = .15
			d.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 98, 74)
		end
	elseif d:IsA("ScrollingFrame")then
		d.ScrollBarImageColor3 = INK; d.ScrollBarImageTransparency = .4
	elseif d:IsA("UIStroke")then
		if inked(d.Color)then d.Color = INK end
	end
	if d:IsA("Frame")and d.BackgroundTransparency < .95 then
		local c = d.BackgroundColor3
		if math.max(c.R, c.G, c.B) < .35 then d.BackgroundColor3 = INK; d.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(d.BackgroundTransparency, .88) end
	end
end

-- Builds a label.
function M.Label(parent, value, size)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1; t.Text = value; t.FontFace = M.Font; t.TextColor3 = M.Color
	t.TextSize = size or 16; t.TextWrapped = true; t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28); t.Parent = parent
	return t
end

-- Applies theme decoration to a button.
function M.Decorate(control)
	init()
	control.BackgroundTransparency = 1; control.BorderSizePixel = 0; control.FontFace = M.Font
	if control:IsA("GuiButton")then control.AutoButtonColor = false end
	local caption = M.Label(control, control.Text, control.TextSize)
	caption.Name = "Caption"; caption.ZIndex = control.ZIndex + 1; caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	caption.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.03, .04); caption.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.94, .92)
	caption.TextScaled = true
	local limit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); limit.MinTextSize = 14; limit.MaxTextSize = control.TextSize; limit.Parent = caption
	control.TextTransparency = 1
	-- Word buttons sit on a bound strip; the chosen one (gold text) gets the purple strip.
	if utf8.len(control.Text) and utf8.len(control.Text) > 1 then
		local strip = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		strip.Name = "Strip"; strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1; strip.Image = STRIP; strip.ZIndex = control.ZIndex
		strip.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice; strip.SliceCenter = STRIP_SLICE; strip.SliceScale = .32
		strip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); strip.Parent = control
		caption.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.1, .1); caption.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.84, .8)
		local function pick()local c = control.TextColor3; strip.Image = (c==RED or inked(c)==RED) and STRIP_ACTIVE or STRIP end
		control:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(pick); pick()
		control.MouseEnter:Connect(function()strip.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 215)end)
		control.MouseLeave:Connect(function()strip.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)end)
	end

	-- Syncs theme on display changes.
	local function sync()
		caption.Text = control.Text; caption.TextColor3 = control.TextColor3
		limit.MaxTextSize = control.TextSize; caption.FontFace = control.Text=="×" and Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold) or M.Font
	end
	control:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(sync)
	control:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(sync)
	control:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextSize"):Connect(sync)
	sync()
	return control
end

-- Builds a themed button.
function M.Button(parent, value, size)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Text = value; b.TextSize = 20; b.TextColor3 = M.Color; b.FontFace = M.Font; b.TextWrapped = true
	b.Size = size or UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42); b.ZIndex = 3; b.Parent = parent
	return M.Decorate(b)
end

-- Creates a template view.
function M.Create(name)
	init()
	local page = Instance.new("Frame")
	page.Name = name; page.BackgroundTransparency = 1; page.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	page.Active = true; page.Visible = false; page.ClipsDescendants = true; page.Parent = host
	local closed = Instance.new("BindableEvent"); closed.Name = "Closed"; closed.Parent = page
	local view = {Page = page, Closed = closed.Event, Root = root, Host = host}

	-- Hides the view.
	function view:Hide()
		page.Visible = false
		if active==view then active = nil; root.Visible = false end
	end

	-- Shows the view.
	function view:Show()
		if active and active~=view then
			local old = active; old:Hide(); old._Closed:Fire()
		end
		active = view; root.Visible = true; page.Visible = true; hud.Enabled = true
	end
	view._Closed = closed

	-- Watches layout changes.
	function view:WatchLayout(callback)
		host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()callback(host.AbsoluteSize)end)
		callback(host.AbsoluteSize)
	end
	return view
end



return M

TopButtonTheme.source:
-- TopButtonTheme: top-bar button theme.
local Gui = game:GetService("GuiService")
local T = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 21), Transparency = .08, Size = 44, Spacing = 52}

-- Top-bar Y offset.
function T.Y()
	local inset = Gui.TopbarInset
	return math.max(8, (inset.Height > 0 and inset.Height or 58) - 46)
end

-- Styles a top button.
function T.Style(button)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = T.Color
	button.BackgroundTransparency = T.Transparency
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
end



return T
